## Kiểm tra database

Bảng `FAM_MoveVoucherDetail` **đã có đủ cột** khớp với màn hình tài sản:

Form popup là `frmDeviceSelect` → `UDeviceList`. Cột `IsSelected` bị ẩn khi chọn đơn và store có thể chưa trả cột này. Đang bổ sung store, lưới và logic hiển thị.

input.contents:
/*
	Patch  : [dbo].[FAM_Device_SearchForSelect]
	Date   : 2025-09-15
	Module : FAM
	Mô tả  : Popup chọn tài sản (frmDeviceSelect) - thêm cột IsSelected và cột hiển thị lưới
	Cách chạy:
		SSMS → chọn đúng database → F5 chạy toàn file.
*/

Set Nocount On;
Go

If Object_Id(N'dbo.FAM_Device_SearchForSelect', N'P') Is Not Null
	Drop Procedure dbo.FAM_Device_SearchForSelect;
Go

Create Procedure dbo.FAM_Device_SearchForSelect
(
	@Keyword nvarchar(200) = null,
	@DeviceName nvarchar(200) = null,
	@DeviceCode nvarchar(50) = null,
	@DeviceKindID int = null,
	@InputVoucherDateFrom datetime = null,
	@InputVoucherDateTo datetime = null,
	@UsingDepartmentID int = null,
	@UsingRoomID nvarchar(50) = null
)
As
Begin
	Set Nocount On;

	Select
		Cast(0 as bit) as IsSelected,
		FAM_Device.DeviceID,
		FAM_Device.DeviceCode,
		FAM_Device.DeviceName,
		FAM_Device.TechInfo,
		FAM_DeviceKind.DeviceKindName,
		FAM_DeviceStatus.DeviceStatusName,
		FAM_Device.LabelNo,
		FAM_Device.MadeIn,
		FAM_Device.Supplier,
		FAM_Device.OfficeID,
		SYS_Office.OfficeName,
		FAM_Device.PlaceID,
		GEN_Place.PlaceName,
		FAM_Device.UsingEmployeeID,
		HRS_Employee.Fullname as UsingEmployeeName,
		FAM_Device.InputVoucherDate,
		FAM_Device.Price,
		GEN_Unit.UnitName,
		FAM_Device.Quantity
	From FAM_Device
		Left Join FAM_DeviceKind on FAM_DeviceKind.DeviceKindID = FAM_Device.DeviceKindID
		Left Join FAM_DeviceStatus on FAM_DeviceStatus.DeviceStatusID = FAM_Device.DeviceStatusID
		Left Join GEN_Unit on GEN_Unit.UnitID = FAM_Device.UnitID
		Left Join SYS_Office on SYS_Office.OfficeID = FAM_Device.OfficeID
		Left Join GEN_Place on GEN_Place.PlaceID = FAM_Device.PlaceID
		Left Join HRS_Employee on HRS_Employee.EmployeeID = FAM_Device.UsingEmployeeID
		Left Join SIM_Room on SIM_Room.RoomID = FAM_Device.UsingRoomID
		Left Join SYS_Department on SYS_Department.DepartmentID =
			(
				Case
					When FAM_Device.UsingRoomID <> N'0' Then SIM_Room.DepartmentID
					Else FAM_Device.UsingDepartmentID
				End
			)
	Where FAM_Device.IsDeleted = 0
		and FAM_Device.ParentDeviceID = 0
		and
		(
			@Keyword Is Null
			or Ltrim(Rtrim(@Keyword)) = N''
			or FAM_Device.DeviceCode like N'%' + @Keyword + N'%'
			or FAM_Device.DeviceName like N'%' + @Keyword + N'%'
			or FAM_Device.TechInfo like N'%' + @Keyword + N'%'
			or FAM_Device.LabelNo like N'%' + @Keyword + N'%'
		)
		and
		(
			@DeviceName Is Null
			or Ltrim(Rtrim(@DeviceName)) = N''
			or FAM_Device.DeviceName like N'%' + @DeviceName + N'%'
		)
		and
		(
			@DeviceCode Is Null
			or Ltrim(Rtrim(@DeviceCode)) = N''
			or FAM_Device.DeviceCode like N'%' + @DeviceCode + N'%'
		)
		and
		(
			@DeviceKindID Is Null
			or @DeviceKindID = 0
			or FAM_Device.DeviceKindID = @DeviceKindID
		)
		and
		(
			@InputVoucherDateFrom Is Null
			or FAM_Device.InputVoucherDate >= @InputVoucherDateFrom
		)
		and
		(
			@InputVoucherDateTo Is Null
			or FAM_Device.InputVoucherDate < DateAdd(day, 1, Convert(date, @InputVoucherDateTo))
		)
		and
		(
			@UsingRoomID Is Null
			or @UsingRoomID = N'0'
			or Ltrim(Rtrim(@UsingRoomID)) = N''
			or FAM_Device.UsingRoomID = @UsingRoomID
		)
		and
		(
			@UsingDepartmentID Is Null
			or @UsingDepartmentID = 0
			or SYS_Department.DepartmentID = @UsingDepartmentID
		)
	Order By FAM_Device.OrderIndex, FAM_Device.DeviceCode, FAM_Device.DeviceID;
End
Go
